Ningposide B is known to interact with CX-1, indicating a possible chain of action where the drug influences the activity of a dehydrogenase/reductase enzyme, which then modulates the target CX-1. This suggests that the drug may act as a modulator of CX-1 through an intermediate enzyme, potentially affecting cellular processes involving the CX-1 receptor. The evidence supports a mechanism where the drug's interaction with the SDR family member leads to a downstream effect on CX-1, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
